tools.description:
Add one exactly named declared member variable with type-checked default and metadata. Conflicts fail rather than silently renaming. No full compile or save is requested; implicit skeleton compilation is reported separately. Unsupported types/defaults/dependencies fail before editing. Full legacy type coverage remains separately tracked.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact runtime-safe /Game Blueprint package/object path, or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. No registry-wide ambiguous name search.
            variable_name: Exact new ASCII identifier, 1..100 characters, not None. Existing names and identity conflicts fail.
            variable_type: bool/boolean, int/integer, int64/integer64, float/single, double/real, string, name, text, Vector, Rotator, Transform, or audited struct/scriptstruct, enum/byteenum, object/class with type_object. Delegates, interfaces, maps, sets and soft-reference descriptors remain unsupported. Native typed defaults must survive an exact engine text export/import roundtrip; values that cannot are rejected before editing.
            is_exposed: Defaults False. True enables instance editing; combined with is_editable using the legacy logical OR.
            default_value_json: Explicit JSON string adapter for legacy Any. Omitted/null, or the JSON text null, means no supplied add default, matching legacy default_value=None. Other values retain their JSON types. Text at most 65536 UTF-16 units, depth 8 and 1024 values; duplicate keys, nonfinite values, magnitudes above 2^53-1, NUL and unpaired surrogates fail.
            category: Optional category, at most 1023 UTF-16 units. Omitted/null/empty means no override.
            tooltip: Optional tooltip, at most 4096 UTF-16 units; line breaks permitted. Omitted/null/empty means no override.
            friendly_name: Optional display name, at most 1023 UTF-16 units. Omitted/null/empty means no override.
            type_object: Optional exact runtime-safe type path when required by the descriptor. Object/class without a type defaults to Object. Referenced assets require a complete saved dependency audit; unaudited plugin/native-module references fail.
            is_array: Legacy array request, default False. Explicit array defaults have at most 256 elements with recursively typed validation; unsupported combinations fail. Arbitrary raw Unreal import text is not accepted for aggregates.
            metadata_json: JSON object, default {}, at most 64 string/bool/finite-number values. Keys at most 1023 UTF-16 units and case-insensitively unique; string values at most 4096 units. Unsupported metadata effects fail explicitly.
            operation_id: Optional durable replay ID. The same ID and normalized arguments return the historical result; uncertain operations never automatically retry.
            variable_guid: Optional legacy internal-command GUID. Must be nonzero, valid and unique; omitted/null/empty lets the engine create one.
            is_editable: Optional legacy internal-command alias. Effective instance editing is is_exposed OR is_editable; False does not override True is_exposed.

tools.description:
Clone a saved, clean ordinary Blueprint below an explicit root, defaulting to dry-run. Preserves the legacy defaults and named command. Source file/loaded state and clone class, K2 graph topology/native pin types, variable descriptors/current CDO are checked; GUIDs can legitimately change in the clone. Requires SaveOnCompile=Never and source control disabled because public duplication implicitly compiles and has no SkipSave option. Settings are never changed. Loading and engine duplication may have callback/selection effects; full asset parity, cold reload and packaged execution are not claimed by this call.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: /Game Blueprint package/object path, export-text or .uasset spelling, or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Requires exact UBlueprint asset class, a native runtime parent or an inspected saved clean compiled Actor Blueprint parent chain, current generated class/CDO and clean saved source dependencies. Parent source hashes/loaded state are independently observed. Observation is bounded to 64 graphs, 2048 nodes per graph/4096 total and the existing 4096-variable/package-audit limits. Derived asset classes remain unsupported; component-template/comment content is not fully audited.
            target_path: New /Game package/object path strictly below required_root. Existing registry/disk/loaded packages or directories and source-equals-target fail. Complete object path at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls. Nothing is deleted.
            required_root: Defaults /Game/_MCP_Temp; explicit empty preserves that legacy default. Target must be below this directory, not equal to it. Use a dedicated owned folder for verification.
            dry_run: Defaults True. True runs preflight/readback with no duplicate, compile or save; requested compile/save flags remain visible with attempted False. Read loading is not a guarantee of no PostLoad callbacks.
            overwrite_existing: Defaults False. True is explicitly unsupported in this slice, including when the target does not exist. No destructive delete/recreate fallback.
            allow_dirty_source: Defaults False. Actual dirty sources are rejected even when True; safe dirty-source equivalence remains pending. Clean sources may pass either value.
            compile: Defaults False. Requests one additional explicit diagnostic compile with node refresh; engine PostDuplicate implicit compilation is reported separately even when False.
            save: Defaults True. Requests one explicit save after clone readback and any requested compile. False keeps the new asset unsaved and verifies no target file appeared. Save failure fails the whole result and preserves known creation state.
            operation_id: Optional durable replay ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Identical ID/arguments replay historical results; uncertain clone/save outcomes never automatically retry.

tools.description:
Connect existing standard K2 pins using the legacy named contract. Ordinary calls accept only direct MAKE or an existing reciprocal link. Explicit guarded replacement supports one exec source link to one exact old input and an empty new input, with current schema BREAK_OTHERS_A. Replacement requires an idle normal Blueprint, a directly owned standard K2 graph and native parent modules limited to Engine/CoreUObject. All four expected fields are required together with permission; a stale expectation fails before already-connected handling. The historical pipeline expected-field contract is restored here; the current UE56 wrapper did not expose those fields. Conversion/promotion nodes, data replacement, multiple old links, occupied new targets and compile/save remain unsupported. No atomic rollback or automatic retry. False native returns and exceptions retain independent after observations when available; lost dispatch responses remain uncertain even if a graph delta was observed.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Runtime-safe /Game Blueprint path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints.
            source_node_id: Exact output node object path or nonzero native GUID, resolved in the selected graph.
            source_pin: Exact output pin name; legacy source_pin spelling is preserved.
            target_node_id: Exact new input node object path or nonzero native GUID.
            target_pin: Exact input pin name; legacy target_pin spelling is preserved.
            graph_name: Optional existing graph name. Omitted/empty selectors resolve the existing default event graph.
            graph_id: Optional nonzero graph GUID; must agree with other selectors.
            graph_type: Optional supported existing graph filter; no graph is created.
            allow_pin_link_replacement: False by default. True requires every expected field and the narrow exec replacement checks.
            compile: Legacy False default. True is explicitly unsupported; compile in a separate named action after graph edits succeed.

tools.description:
Create a validated call node for an audited Engine native static function, an already compiled own function, or a compiled own function of an audited saved non-scene ActorComponent class. The exact native ActorComponent.GetOwner instance function is additionally supported with an explicit ActorComponent self input. Audited object signatures are limited to GetOwner, KismetSystemLibrary.IsValid and GameplayStatics.GetPlayerController; other native functions retain the scalar primitive signature restriction. GetPlayerController requires a standard owning-instance world context and does not establish that a controller exists at runtime. Typed defaults and exact function/pin readback are preserved. This tool preserves legacy identity: data_json.node_id and node_guid are GUIDs; object_path is the canonical node path. Existing inspect_graph/member-node tools keep node_id as an object path. No function execution, explicit full compile or save. The older loose add_blueprint_function_node target/self inference remains a separate pending contract.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Runtime-safe /Game Blueprint path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints.
            function_class: Exact audited /Script/Engine native static owner (or /Script/Engine.ActorComponent for GetOwner), the target Blueprint's own current /Game/..._C, or an exact saved clean compiled non-scene ActorComponent /Game/Package.Package_C. Generated calls require compiled own bytecode and matching skeleton signature/GUID. Own calls use self context; external component calls expose the exact generated-class self input for explicit wiring. Source loading/PostLoad may occur and scoped source/target observations are returned. SKEL/REINST inputs, inherited functions, arbitrary external classes and direct own recursion remain unsupported. Editor/MCP dependencies are forbidden; compiled/current function paths are reported separately.
            function_name: Exact UFunction name, independent of localized menu labels.
            param_defaults_json: Strict JSON object of up to 64 distinct pin names; JSON null normalizes to {} like legacy None. Native checks each supported scalar default before mutation. Audited object inputs accept JSON null only; concrete object/class literals and explicit world-context defaults are unsupported. Wire object values with a direct schema-approved connection. Unknown/unsupported pins fail. JSON adapters cap 65536 UTF-16 units, depth 8 and 1024 values; finite numbers have magnitude at most 2^53-1.

            allow_editor_only: Legacy False default; True is always rejected for persistent runtime assets.

batch.description: Ordered Blueprint/graph/component actions sharing one durable journal, without automatic rollback/retry.

tools.description:
Execute 1..100 explicitly supported Blueprint/graph/component actions in order on the game thread.

        Args:
            commands_json: JSON array of {"type":"CubelessBlueprintTools.create_blueprint","params":{"name":"BP_Name","parent_class":"Actor","package_path":"/Game/Blueprints"}} entries. Allowed CubelessBlueprintTools functions: create_blueprint, inspect_blueprint, compile_blueprint, compile_and_save_blueprint, compile_and_validate_blueprint, add_blueprint_variable, inspect_blueprint_variables, inspect_blueprint_variable_metadata, set_blueprint_variable_default. Allowed CubelessBlueprintGraphTools functions: inspect_graph, add_branch_node, set_node_position, delete_node, connect_graph_pins, add_blueprint_variable_get_node, add_blueprint_variable_set_node, resolve_blueprint_graph, add_blueprint_function_parameter, add_blueprint_call_function_node. Function actions use existing selectors and strict JSON adapters, with native unsupported options rejected before mutation; create a function graph in a separate resolve action before adding its input/call node. They perform no explicit full compile/save. Graph selectors accept object-path node_id or native GUID; direct typed links preserve existing topology and refuse conversion/promotion nodes or link replacement. Member-node tools retain the bounded own, inherited and external scopes documented by their individual tools. Allowed CubelessComponentTools functions: list_blueprint_components, get_component_property, add_component_to_blueprint, set_component_property, set_static_mesh_properties, set_physics_properties. Use each individual tool's exact parameters/defaults except operation_id, which belongs only to the whole batch. Set component add compile_blueprint=false and variable default compile=false/save=false to accumulate edits before one final named compile/save action. Variable adds never request full compile/save; dry_run retains requested flags but executes neither. The named mesh setter accepts material for slot 0; material-only edits require static_mesh as an explicit empty string plus a valid material path. Omitted/null material preserves existing mesh-only batch replay. Physics defaults request no compile/save or running simulation; numeric int/float inputs normalize to numbers without the int32 coordinate restriction. Up to 1 MiB input. No legacy aliases, result references, arbitrary tools or nested batches. All command names/types are checked before any action. Individual domain restrictions still apply.
            stop_on_error: Defaults True. False continues only known failures; uncertain mutation, journal failure, PIE/session guard, or the 15-second between-step budget always stops. One engine call cannot be preempted.
            operation_id: Durable whole-batch ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Same ID and normalized inputs replay the recorded response without rerunning. Interrupted IDs never resume automatically.

        The named duplicate_blueprint_to_temp action is also supported under CubelessBlueprintTools with its individual defaults (dry_run=True, compile=False, save=True). It requires a clean saved source and SaveOnCompile=Never/source-control-disabled policy; engine implicit PostDuplicate compilation is separately reported. Overwrite and dirty-source cloning remain unsupported. It uses this batch journal, never a nested operation/retry.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.add_blueprint_sequence_node is supported with its individual defaults and JSON position adapter; it adds 2..64 ordered exec outputs to an existing selected graph without compiler/save calls. It preserves GUID-valued node_id plus object_path. Its shared creation core and the existing Branch tool verify old graph topology. All domain limitations still apply.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.connect_blueprint_graph_pins preserves legacy source_pin/target_pin and graph selectors, sharing the ordinary connection core. Replacement requires allow_pin_link_replacement=true and all four expected fields naming exactly one current exec edge with schema break_others_a; the new target must be empty. Native dispatch rechecks the guard after checkpoint. Compile/save flags must remain false. Reconnecting the old path is a separate explicit action; failure can leave a partial chain, never an atomic transaction. Existing connect_graph_pins remains replacement-free with its original signature and journal fingerprint.

        CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.add_blueprint_event_node and the new add_blueprint_parent_function_call extension share the same durable action core. Their existing graph selectors, JSON positions and explicit unsupported options match the named tools. No implicit wiring/full compile/save. Actor Blueprint parents are admitted only by the saved clean compiled chain/dependency guard; native parent creation/duplication defaults and replay fingerprints remain unchanged. Component getters support the audited local generated ActorComponent scope described by their individual tool.

        Member get/set actions additionally accept target_class for own readable/writable members of an exact saved clean compiled non-scene ActorComponent, plus graph_id/graph_type/node_position_json adapters. Omitted additive options preserve old batch replay fingerprints. CubelessBlueprintGraphTools.set_blueprint_pin_default is supported with required value_json and its individual selector/direction defaults. It changes one unlinked input literal, with typed requested-value and independent whole-graph preservation checks; no compile/save. Runtime Engine object references are bounded by individual tool guards. These state operations do not implement input-device dispatch or complete legacy mouse/controller pipelines.

        Returns:
            data_json.batch contains ordered child results, attempted/observed changes, partial results, skipped steps, per-step compile/save, forced-stop reason and timing. Full compilation/saving occur in explicitly requested actions; engine factories and structural edits may perform separately reported implicit compiler work. One transaction scope does not promise atomic rollback, disk recovery or all-action Undo support. Completed reads replay historical results for the same ID. Long asynchronous work and full legacy command coverage are not implemented.
tools.name: cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.batch_toolset.CubelessBatchTools.execute_batch

tools.description:
Replaces a node's baked-in class reference from old_class to new_class in place.

        If the node's current class reference matches old_class it is replaced with
        new_class and the node is reconstructed so its pins reflect the new type.
        If the node already references new_class the call is a no-op.

        When a Blueprint is duplicated, nodes in the copied graph retain class references
        pointing to the original Blueprint. Calling this on each node with the original
        and duplicate classes retargets them without manual delete-recreate-rewire cycles.

        Handles cast, function call, event, and multicast delegate nodes. The Blueprint
        must be compiled after all retargeting is complete.

        Args:
            node: The node to retarget.
            old_class: The class currently baked into the node.
            new_class: The replacement class.

tools.description:
Set the legacy named physics-default group on one local unregistered component template. Supports exact Engine StaticMeshComponent, SphereComponent, BoxComponent and CapsuleComponent only. Uses public physics setters and independently observes stored defaults; no physics simulation, full compile or save is requested or verified. Inherited/native templates, external propagation and live physics state are unsupported. Corrects the old handler's ignored gravity_enabled input.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Selectors are at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls.
            component_name: Exact reachable local SCS variable name; unsupported component types fail before requested editing.
            simulate_physics: Boolean, default True. Sets the template simulation default, not a running simulation.
            gravity_enabled: Boolean, default True. Applied through the public gravity setter; legacy_gravity_ignored_fixed records this intentional behavior correction.
            mass: Kilogram override, default 1.0. Finite number from 0.001 to 1e12; booleans/strings/null are rejected. The lower bound follows the public BodyInstance editor mass constraint and is stricter than legacy. Native storage is float32 and reports its actual rounded value.
            linear_damping: Finite number from 0 to 1e12, default 0.01; bool/string/null rejected. Same float32 observation rule as mass.
            angular_damping: Finite number from 0 to 1e12, default 0.0; bool/string/null rejected. Same float32 observation rule as mass.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. One journal and action core are shared by standalone and named batch use. Replays never execute again; partial or unknown outcomes require inspection and are never automatically retried.

        Returns:
            Standard mutation outcome retaining data.component, physics_before/physics_after, legacy_gravity_ignored_fixed and runtime_simulation_verified=false. Actual changes and no-op results remain explicit. No atomic rollback is promised.
tools.name: cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.component_toolset.CubelessComponentTools.set_physics_properties

data_json.description: JSON object containing operation-specific output and legacy contract fields.

retry_json.description: JSON object describing retry policy, duplicate risk and request replay.

validation_json.description: JSON object describing performed checks and missing validation, including reload.

save_json.description: JSON object describing requested/attempted save and saved state.

compile_json.description: JSON object describing requested/attempted compile, status and diagnostics.

changes_json.description: JSON array of attempted and observed changes; no atomic rollback.

tools.description:
Set the mesh and/or material slot 0 of an exact native StaticMeshComponent in the Blueprint's reachable local SCS. Preserves the legacy named tool, Cube default, positional operation_id and data.component result while restoring the old native material branch. Both requested references are prevalidated before editing; invalid references fail explicitly instead of silent success. No full compile or save is requested. Supported classes/dependencies/propagation remain bounded, not full internal-command parity.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Inherited/native CDO templates, custom component subclasses and external instance propagation are unsupported.
            component_name: Exact reachable local component variable name, at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls. A non-StaticMeshComponent fails explicitly.
            static_mesh: /Engine or /Game StaticMesh package/object path, default /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube.Cube. For material-only edits, explicitly pass an empty string AND a valid material path. An empty mesh without a material remains invalid. Omission selects Cube even when material is supplied; null is not a leave-unchanged sentinel because the official conversion can apply the Cube default. Complete paths are at most 1023 UTF-16 units. General set_component_property with JSON null is a distinct mesh-clear operation.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Its positional location is preserved. Mesh-only normalized arguments and existing journal replay remain unchanged. Replay never executes again; unknown results are not automatically retried.

tools.description:
Add one local SCS component with validated initial properties and observed hierarchy. Supports a runtime-safe /Game Actor Blueprint, seven exact Engine classes, and an audited saved clean compiled non-scene ActorComponent generated class. Inherited/native templates, arbitrary plugin classes and external property propagation remain unsupported. Never saves. Unlike legacy's ignored component_properties, unsupported values fail explicitly.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Selectors are at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls; native name/template-slot guards can be stricter.
            component_type: Runtime Engine SceneComponent, StaticMeshComponent, CameraComponent, SpringArmComponent, SphereComponent, BoxComponent or CapsuleComponent; U-prefix, /Script/Engine and short base-name aliases are preserved. Alternatively an exact /Game/Package.Package_C non-scene ActorComponent class with saved clean compiled source and audited runtime dependencies. Generated components require identity transforms, no parent and {} initial properties; saved defaults are retained. Class loading/PostLoad observations and one explicit skeleton refresh are reported separately from optional full compilation.
            component_name: Requested exact new local component variable name: ASCII identifier with 1..100 characters, not None. Existing/conflicting names fail without silently generating a different identity.
            location_json: JSON string [X,Y,Z], default [0,0,0]. Exactly three finite numbers, not booleans; magnitude at most 1e12.
            rotation_json: JSON string [Pitch,Yaw,Roll], default [0,0,0], with the same numeric bounds.
            scale_json: JSON string [X,Y,Z], default [1,1,1], with the same numeric bounds.
            parent_component: Optional exact existing local scene parent for native classes. Omitted/null/empty uses the sole local scene root, typically DefaultSceneRoot. Multiple roots require an explicit parent; an empty valid SCS may create its first root. Generated non-scene components require omission/null/empty and are added as local SCS root nodes.
            component_properties_json: Explicit JSON-object adapter for legacy heterogeneous properties, default {}. At most 64 fields. Native typed scalar/vector/rotator/color/enum/name/string/text subset only; arbitrary aggregates/object/class references unsupported except checked StaticMeshComponent.StaticMesh. Shape fields: SphereRadius, BoxExtent (three numbers or broadcast number), CapsuleRadius and CapsuleHalfHeight; sizes must be finite, nonnegative and at most 1e12, with capsule radius <= half-height. Both capsule fields may be supplied together. Use the transform arguments for RelativeLocation/RelativeRotation/RelativeScale3D; conflicting property fields fail. JSON text at most 65536 UTF-16 units, depth 8 and 1024 values; duplicate keys, nonfinite/numeric magnitude beyond 2^53-1, NUL and unpaired surrogates fail before dispatch. Property names at most 1023 UTF-16 units.
            compile_blueprint: True preserves legacy's full compile boundary with diagnostics and SkipSave. False explicitly defers full compile for authoring batches; implicit structural engine work is separately reported. Finish the batch with one named compile action.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Same ID and normalized arguments replay its recorded result. Interrupted or uncertain operations never automatically retry.
